<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Rich text: the body of the current page or post (trusted markup from the content source) styled by Prose,
  under its title and a meta line (date, author, category). Axes: layout (narrow: one reading column; wide: a
  wider column; sidebar: the body and a side note; media: a cover above the body; card: the body in a card;
  hero: the title as the page heading over a wide cover), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { RichEntry, RichMedia, RichMeta, RichAside } from "./rich-text.types";
  import type { TrustedHtml } from "../utils";

  export type RichTextProps = {
    id: string;
    title?: string;
    content?: TrustedHtml;
    media?: RichMedia;
    meta?: RichMeta;
    aside?: RichAside;
    level?: 1 | 2;
    layout?: "narrow" | "wide" | "sidebar" | "media" | "card" | "hero";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Card from "../compose/Card.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Prose from "../compose/Prose.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import Pill from "../components/pill.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { htmlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title = "",
    content,
    media,
    meta,
    aside,
    level = 2,
    layout = "narrow",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: RichTextProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  heading={{ level }}
  tone={tone}
  density={density}
  measure={
    ((layout as string) === "narrow") || ((layout as string) === "media") ? "2xl"
    : (layout as string) === "card" ? "3xl"
    : "default"
  }
  boxed={((layout as string) === "card")}
  landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
>
  {#if (meta?.date || meta?.author || meta?.category)}
    <Group gap="4" align="center" class="flex-wrap" data-slot="richtext-meta">
      {#if meta?.date}
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {meta?.date}
        </Text>
      {/if}
      {#if meta?.author}
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
          {meta?.author}
        </Text>
      {/if}
      {#if meta?.category}
        <Pill tone="blue">
          {meta?.category}
        </Pill>
      {/if}
    </Group>
  {/if}
  {#if (((layout as string) === "hero") || ((layout as string) === "media"))}
    <MediaFrame
      alt={(media?.alt ?? title)}
      src={media?.src}
      ratio={(((layout as string) === "hero") ? "21/9" : "16/9")}
    />
  {/if}
  {#if ((layout as string) === "sidebar")}
    <Grid cols="1" class="gap-8 lg:grid-cols-3">
      <Box class="min-w-0 lg:col-span-2">
        {#if content}
          <Prose size="base" width="none" data-slot="richtext-content">
            {@html htmlOf(content)}
          </Prose>
        {/if}
      </Box>
      {#if aside?.content}
        <Card variant="compact" class="h-fit">
          {#if aside?.title}
            <Title as={((level === 1) ? 2 : 3)} size="lg" weight="semibold">
              {aside?.title}
            </Title>
          {/if}
          {#if aside?.content}
            <Prose size="sm" width="none" data-slot="richtext-aside-content">
              {@html htmlOf(aside?.content)}
            </Prose>
          {/if}
        </Card>
      {/if}
    </Grid>
  {:else if content}
    <Prose
      size="base"
      width={
        (layout as string) === "wide" ? "wide"
        : (layout as string) === "hero" ? "narrow"
        : "none"
      }
      data-slot="richtext-content"
    >
      {@html htmlOf(content)}
    </Prose>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
